tools.name: create_game
tools.description: Mint a new game (publishable key) under your studio (secret key). Returns its publishableKey + wsEndpoint. Point a client at the new key, or scope this MCP to it by passing the x-mp-game header.

tools.name: list_games
tools.description: List the games (publishable keys) under your studio, with labels and per-game settings. Marks which game is `primary` (the one unnamed calls fall back to) and which one this connection is currently pointed at.

tools.name: set_game_name
tools.description: Set a human-readable name for a game (the `game` argument, else the x-mp-game header, else your only game). The name shows in your dashboard: call this when you start building so the game isn't unnamed. Refuses to guess when the studio has several games and none was named.

tools.name: define_room_type
tools.description: Create or replace the spec for a room (validation/types/defaults). Returns connection info. Omit fields entirely for a fully schemaless room.

tools.name: get_connection_info
tools.description: Returns { wsEndpoint, roomName, publishableKey, adsPublisherId } for wiring a client. adsPublisherId is your BYO Google Ads id (embed it if set). Check the returned `target` names the game you meant before shipping the key.

tools.name: get_client_snippet
tools.description: Returns a complete single-file HTML game wired to this room: realtime movement plus an anonymous (claimable) player, a saved color (datastore), and a click leaderboard. Write it to disk and open it. The game it is wired to is stamped in a comment at the top of the file.

tools.name: get_sdk_reference
tools.description: Returns the full SDK reference (markdown) wired to ONE game's key/endpoints: realtime rooms, player identity (anonymous + claim/login), the datastore (saves/stats/inventory), leaderboards, player-created content (level sharing / UGC), and durable shared MATCHES for asynchronous turn-based play. findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_client_snippet, connect_account · Private data: create_game, get_client_snippet, publish_game, connect_account · Public sink: publish_game, connect_account · Destructive: publish_game.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_client_snippet, connect_account · Private data: create_game, get_client_snippet, publish_game, connect_account · Public sink: publish_game, connect_account · Destructive: publish_game

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
